description: This file defines an abstract base class for prompt management in a language model interface. It includes method signatures for prompting, prompt compilation, and post-processing, along with some concrete implementations. The class is intended to be subclassed for specific prompt management strategies.

classes.name: PromptManagementClient
classes.description: TypedDict defining the structure for prompt management client data, including prompt ID, prompt template, model info, and completed messages.

classes.name: PromptManagementBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing an interface and default methods for prompt management, including prompt compilation, message merging, and prompt-based chat completion workflows.
